typography.headings: Fredoka, Nunito, or Space Grotesk (Playful/Youth brands). DO NOT use Inter/Roboto for headings.
typography.body: Inter or Figtree, clean and highly readable.

colors.theme: Light theme strongly preferred for playful/ecommerce. Dark theme is not recommended for this brand identity.

visual_enhancers.borders: Neo-brutalist solid black borders (1px to 2px) for cards and buttons.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Hard offset shadows (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]) instead of soft blurs.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Rectangular cards with sharp edges, or pill-shaped buttons. Avoid standard 8px border-radius.
visual_enhancers.overlays: Never use transparent backgrounds without heavy backdrop blur. No generic full-screen gradients.

component_rules.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp boxes with hard offset shadow that translates down on click.
component_rules.cards: Cardless or neo-brutalist bordered cards. DO NOT use generic Vercel/Stripe card styles.
component_rules.forms: Use customized Shadcn UI components. Do not use raw HTML inputs.

grids_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Tailwind scale: p-8, p-12. Avoid cramped interfaces.
grids_layouts.structure: Bento Grid (Mode A) with tension and asymmetry. Never fill 100% perfectly, leave breathing room.
grids_layouts.alignment: Left-align paragraphs and dense content. Center-align hero selectively.

motion.interactions: Hover states must include color shift and slight transform (e.g., -translate-y-1).
motion.transitions: Use specific transition properties (e.g., transition-transform), NEVER transition-all.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio for standard text and 3:1 for large text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Always apply a `data-testid` to buttons, links, and forms.
Use JS/JSX rules, do not use TSX instructions.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs.
Avoid standard center alignment for app containers (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
Use layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Create depth through offset solid shadows for this neo-brutalist vibe.
